title: CCTNS Operational Police Stations
contribution: Reports all 17798 police stations using CCTNS as of 2026-02-01 and describes NDC replication and standardized codes
limitation: Not a research paper and not an open raw dataset
relation_to_idea: Defines the baseline infrastructure the proposed overlay must complement

title: Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS)
contribution: Describes integration across criminal justice pillars and Data Sharing Matrix
limitation: No implementation details or public operational dataset
relation_to_idea: Justifies CCTNS/ICJS-compatible overlay framing

title: NIST SP 800-162: Guide to Attribute Based Access Control
contribution: Defines ABAC using subject object action and environment attributes
limitation: US federal guidance not India-specific law
relation_to_idea: Primary security baseline for access-request policies

title: Hyperledger Fabric: A Distributed Operating System for Permissioned Blockchains
contribution: Foundational architecture for modular permissioned blockchain with membership identities
limitation: Benchmark is not police-specific and performance depends on deployment
relation_to_idea: Supports Fabric as candidate audit layer for known agencies

title: Attribute-based access control scheme for data sharing on Hyperledger Fabric
method: Fabric chaincode plus ABAC plus encrypted off-chain data
contribution: Shows decentralized fine-grained ABAC pattern with encrypted data and on-chain references
limitation: Generic data-sharing threat model not Indian policing
relation_to_idea: Direct technical baseline for Fabric plus ABAC layer

title: Two-Level Blockchain System for Digital Crime Evidence Management
contribution: Applies blockchain to crime-evidence lifecycle and investigation data
limitation: Evidence management focus, not inter-station access workflow
relation_to_idea: Supports off-chain/on-chain separation and evidence provenance

title: LEChain: A blockchain-based lawful evidence management scheme for digital forensics
contribution: Addresses chain of custody transparency verifiability and evidence handling
limitation: Digital forensics focus; full implementation details need local PDF review
relation_to_idea: Supports lawful evidence audit motivation

title: Design and Implementation of a Digital Evidence Management Model Based on Hyperledger Fabric
contribution: Practical Fabric-based evidence management design
limitation: Not India-specific and not XAI-focused
relation_to_idea: Implementation reference for Fabric evidence audit

title: Blockchain based access control systems: State of the art and challenges
contribution: Maps access-control patterns and challenges
limitation: Survey does not evaluate proposed workflow
relation_to_idea: Prevents overclaiming novelty in blockchain access control

title: Blockchain for Access Control Systems
contribution: Explains blockchain properties for access-control policy models
limitation: General guidance not police-specific
relation_to_idea: Grounds auditability and access-control claims

title: Towards accountable and privacy-preserving blockchain-based access control for data sharing
contribution: Targets permission invisibility access anonymity and accountability
limitation: Complex cryptography may be too heavy for first prototype
relation_to_idea: Future extension for sensitive attribute/privacy handling

title: Blockchain Based Auditable Access Control for Distributed Business Processes
contribution: Shows blockchain audit value in cross-organization processes
limitation: Not policing-specific
relation_to_idea: Useful comparison for inter-agency workflows

title: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning: Methods Challenges and Directions
method: Survey of DP FL HE SMPC and related methods
contribution: Clarifies PPML methods and trade-offs
limitation: Survey not criminal-justice-specific
relation_to_idea: Helps choose privacy techniques without overclaiming

title: Deep Learning with Differential Privacy
contribution: Foundational DP deep-learning method
limitation: DP adds utility trade-offs and is not an access-control system
relation_to_idea: Useful only for optional aggregate model privacy experiments

title: Stop explaining black box machine learning models for high stakes decisions and use interpretable models instead
contribution: Argues for interpretable models in high-stakes settings
limitation: Position paper; not police access-control experiment
relation_to_idea: Supports interpretable-first model design

title: The accuracy fairness and limits of predicting recidivism
method: Empirical comparison of COMPAS and human/simple prediction
contribution: Shows limits of complex criminal-justice risk tools and value of simple baselines
limitation: US recidivism context not Indian policing
relation_to_idea: Warning against overclaiming AI risk scores

title: Fair Prediction with Disparate Impact
contribution: Shows fairness trade-offs in risk prediction
limitation: US recidivism context
relation_to_idea: Defines fairness risks for any crime-risk model

title: Inherent Trade-Offs in the Fair Determination of Risk Scores
contribution: Shows incompatible fairness criteria under differing base rates
limitation: Theoretical and not India-specific
relation_to_idea: Supports limitations section for risk scores

title: Runaway Feedback Loops in Predictive Policing
contribution: Explains feedback-loop risk in police deployment data
limitation: Not India-specific
relation_to_idea: Justifies rejecting individual predictive-policing claims

title: Fundamental considerations for the use of explainable AI in law enforcement
contribution: Emphasizes stakeholder-specific XAI automation-bias risk and AI literacy
limitation: Does not provide system benchmark
relation_to_idea: Supports role-specific explanations for officers auditors and affected persons

title: Dialogue-based XAI for Predictive Policing: a Field Study
contribution: Studies explanation needs in predictive-policing setting
limitation: Workshop source; needs careful citation
relation_to_idea: Informs human-centered explanation layer

title: Blockchain-based auditing of legal decisions supported by explainable AI and generative AI tools
method: Blockchain audit of AI-supported legal decisions
contribution: Connects legal decisions XAI artifacts and audit trails
limitation: Not police access-control specific
relation_to_idea: Direct support for hashing explanation artifacts into audit log

title: A Secure and Privacy-Preserving Blockchain-Based XAI-Justice System
contribution: Combines blockchain privacy and XAI ideas
limitation: Architecture-level; not proof of effectiveness
relation_to_idea: Related idea but not India CCTNS/ICJS workflow

title: Machine learning in crime prediction
contribution: Summarizes ML crime-prediction methods and challenges
limitation: Broad survey; not India access governance
relation_to_idea: Useful background but not core novelty

title: Analysis of criminal spatial events in India using exploratory data analysis and regression
contribution: India-specific aggregate crime analysis
limitation: Aggregate reported crime only
relation_to_idea: Shows existing NCRB analytics baseline

title: Forecasting Murder Motives in India Using Statistical Analysis and Explainable Artificial Intelligence
contribution: India-specific forecasting plus XAI framing
limitation: Conference source; needs full paper review before claims
relation_to_idea: Shows crime-XAI exists; pushes this project toward access-governance gap

title: CriX: Intersection of Crime Demographics and Explainable AI
dataset: Karnataka/demographic crime dataset as described by authors
contribution: Combines demographics crime and explainability
limitation: Custom dataset and transferability need verification
relation_to_idea: Evidence that XAI crime analytics is adjacent but not sufficient novelty

title: IndianBailJudgments-1200: A Multi-Attribute Dataset for Legal NLP on Indian Bail Orders
contribution: Provides structured criminal-justice legal NLP benchmark
limitation: Court judgments not FIRs or police records
